mainEntity.name: What is the construction process for adding an extra bedroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an extra bedroom addition typically involves consultation, design planning, permitting, site prep, structural framing, exterior envelope finishing, drywall installation, and final interior touches. After your initial free quote and design finalization, our team coordinates trades from foundation pouring to roof integration. Once the room is framed and rough utilities are inspected, drywall is hung and finished, followed by flooring, paint, trim, and matching exterior stucco to ensure a cohesive look. Project timelines depend heavily on structural complexity and municipal permit processing.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from design planning and permitting through foundation, framing, roofing, drywall installation, exterior stucco matching, and final interior trim.
